description: Platform-specific functions for Intel SoC FPGA used by ARM SiP Services to support EL3 communication in Zephyr OS, including mailbox handling, secure monitor calls, and transaction ID management.

methods.name: intel_sip_smc_plat_func_id_valid
methods.description: Validates if a given function ID is supported for a specific command (sync or async).

methods.name: intel_sip_smc_plat_format_trans_id
methods.description: Formats a transaction ID combining client and transaction indices.

methods.name: intel_sip_smc_plat_get_trans_idx
methods.description: Extracts the transaction index from a transaction ID.

methods.name: intel_sip_smc_plat_update_trans_id
methods.description: Updates the request headers with the transaction ID.

methods.name: intel_sip_smc_plat_free_async_memory
methods.description: Frees dynamically allocated memory for asynchronous mailbox requests.

methods.name: intel_sip_smc_plat_async_res_req
methods.description: Prepares parameters for mailbox response request.

methods.name: intel_sip_smc_plat_async_res_res
methods.description: Processes mailbox response, extracting transaction ID and response size.

methods.name: arm_sip_smc_init
methods.description: Initializes the SIP SMC driver and registers it.
